skill_description: Use when asked to repair a small Python product while preserving unrelated behavior.

cases.prompt: Our cart drops the last item's price. Please repair total_price in inputs/product.py so it includes every supplied price and returns zero for an empty cart. We're close to the release deadline, but I need the file changed, not just a suggested snippet. Keep format_reference and all other files byte-for-byte unchanged. Check a single-item cart, a multi-item cart, and an empty cart, then briefly describe the repair.
